messages:
ara_ops: FYI HyperFreight replied on the H100 batch. Lead time 5-7 weeks, but they offered an air-priority partial of 30 units if we cover forwarder premium.
tom: We needed ~50 for NA pools this month. 30 helps but still short. Can we split 30 air + 20 sea and stagger arrival?
lucy_fin: What9s the delta on price for that partial? Need cost to approve premium.
nora_hyperfreight: Nora (HyperFreight): Pricing: air-priority adds +9% per unit (fuel + expedited handling). Remaining sea allocation stays at committed rate. We can also offer a DOA voucher up to 4% (courier + refurb credit) if Redwood signs a 21-day deposit hold.
ara_ops: 4% voucher ok? ops prefers immediate replacement for DOA but voucher might be acceptable if SLA has depot-photo evidence and same-day depot triage.
tom: Conditional accept: take the 30 now via air if vendor 1) provides AWB within 24h, 2) includes depot photo checklist in RMA SLA, 3) guarantees replacement timeline for DOA >4% (we pay to expedite).
ops-bot: Vendor document checklist: AWB, commercial invoice, packing list, HS code, thermal certification for sea.
nora_hyperfreight: Understood. We'll send AWB HX-AP998 for the 30 air units (est 2 business days to US-West). Draft RMA + voucher template inbound. Sea hold scheduled Q3 window.
lucy_fin: Flagging finance: if we accept +9% for first 30, run variance against procurement commit and approve the 21-day deposit clause. Also set a PO line for "forwarder premium" expense code.
ara_ops: Action: lucy to OK deposit by EOD? tom to confirm which 30 units go to west vs east pool. I'll ping procurement for customs PO and thermal cert.
tom: Splitting: send 18 to west pool, 12 to east. Rest 20 sea-staged for July.
lucy_fin: Approved the deposit for up to $250k and premium line. Will track if remaining units get +12% later.
nora_hyperfreight: Sending draft RMA and voucher now. Voucher covers courier pickup + refurb credit and requires depot photo evidence per checklist. We'll mark AWB HX-AP998 as confirmed once we receive payment hold.
ara_ops: Good. One ask: include "no KMS whitelist change without 48h notice" in handoff email for Dedicated pools. We9ve had handoffs blocked before.
nora_hyperfreight: We'll add KMS clause. AWB will be shared in 12-18h.
ombot: Reminder: please attach the customs PO when AWB provided.
ara_ops: Closing loop: once RMA draft is in, i'll confirm deposit and forwarder premium, then vendor to release AWB.
